judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug remains unfixed and the newly added acceptance test will fail. It also omitted the required update to `CHANGELOG.md` and left an untracked `.lore/dod.md` planning file in the repository. On the positive side, the candidate did update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` appropriately and wrote a thorough acceptance test, though it placed the test in a new file (`src/orchestration/beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts`) rather than adding it to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference.
